newsitem.title: GREECE: IFC, NATL BANK JOIN BULGARIAN LEASING COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: IFC, NATL BANK JOIN BULGARIAN LEASING COMPANY.

text.p: Bulgarian leasing company Interlease signed an agreement on Tuesday raising its capital to $2.0 million and bringing in the World Bank's International Finance Corporation (IFC) and the National Bank of Greece as shareholders.

A company statement said the IFC and National Bank joined existing shareholders, the Bulgarian Industrial Association, LeaseHolding BV of the Netherlands, U.S. insurer AIG, and the German development bank Deutsche Investitions und Entwicklungsgesellschaft GmbH (DEG).
The IFC will make a $3.5 million credit to Interlease, the National Bank of Greece plans a $5.0 million credit and DEG has approved a 5.0 million mark credit.
Interlease began operating last year, leasing capital equipment to Bulgarian firms.
